tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅: ngag 'grol gser gyi lde'u mig gi gzhung mngon rtogs dang bcas pa bzhugs:

byad dang ngag 'grol ba'i gdams pa 'di la: dang po bum pa'i nang du chu gtsang ma dang gtsang po'i chu blug go: ba dmar po'i 'o ma dang chu blug: bum pa'i rdzas ni: rab gu ru yab yum gyi byang sems dkar dmar: med na sngags pa nus pa can dang: bud med rigs bzang mo de gnyis kyi byang sems dkar dmar la bya'o: yang na rang gi de la bya'o: bdud rtsi sman sgrub kyi a mṛta dang: bzang drug bsre'o: gla rtsi: shing kun: ram gyi phyi mo: rgya tshwa: phag ma shi ba'i sna: de yang dbugs ma chad tsam la breg par bya'o: shing nya sbrid ma: g.yer ma'i 'bru gu nag po bdun: skyer pa'i 'bru gu bdun: sha ba'i rwa bdar ba'i phye ma dum gcig: bya ngang pa'i sha dum gcig: sbrang rtsi: rdzas de rnams bsres te phye mar byas la bum par blug go: de yis bum chu ngar blud pa'o: rdzas dang sngags kyi nus pas phra men 'gong chog gi rigs thams cad stan du bting yang rang la gnod mi nus so: dus ni skar ma rgyal dang gza' phur bu 'dzom pa'i nyi ma la bya'o: de ma 'dzom na rgyal gyi nyi ma rtse shar la bya'o: rgyal nam byung dus su yang bya'o: spos kyi dud pa btang zhing sngags bzla'o: gzungs ring chen mo ni/ rgya gar skad du: bha ra u sha tsakra nā ma: bod skad du: ngag 'grol ba'i 'khor lo zhes bya ba: rdo rje gtsug gtor rnam par rgyal ba la phyag 'tshal lo: hūm̐: rdo rje gtsug tor phyir zlog pa chen mo: phyag stong mnga' ba chen mo: dbu stong mnga' ba chen mo: spyan bye ba brgya phrag 'bum mnga' ba: me lce 'bar ba'i mtshan rtags can: rdo rje yangs pa chen mo sa gsum gyi dkyil 'khor la mnga' mdzad ma: kun nas gzhan la byed na 'di rnams mal du bsrung bya zhes sgyur/ bdag cag mi nor 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la: nyin dang mtshan du srung du gsol: hūm̐: khro bo'i rgyal po ngag dang byad 'grol ba rnam par rgyal ba la phyag 'tshal lo: gang dag bdag la mi phan par 'dod pa dang:

rnam par sdang ba dang: gnod par sems pa dang: ngan sngags byed pa dang: byad du bcug pa dang: gtad byed pa dang: khram la 'debs pa dang: rbod gtong byed pa dang: sbyin sreg byed pa dang: mnan pa dang: bcings pa dang: ngag mnan pa dang: dmod mo byed pa dang: hom dang par bu bskor ba dang: rlung nag 'khrugs pas bskor ba dang: steng lha yis bcings pa dang: 'og klu yis bcings pa dang: bar lha srin sde brgyad kyis bcings pa dang: phra men gyis bcings pa dang: phra men gyis byad du bcug nas bdag cag rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum gtad khram la btab pa dang: byad stems su bcug pa dang: bcings pa thams cad rnam par gzhig tu gsol: rnam par gzhom du gsol lo: bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum bcings pa dang byad du bcug pa thams cad khrol du gsol: nges par khrol du gsol lo: gzhan gyis ngag gi nus pa bshig pa thams cad khrol du gsol: nges par khrol du gsol: rtsa sngags/ tad+ya thā: oṃ a na le a na le: bhi ṣa dhe bhi ṣa dhe: bhai ra bhai ra: badz+ra dhā ra ṇi: bhan+dha bhan+dha ni: badz+ra pā ṇi phaṭa: hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā: hūm̐ drūṃ bhan+dha bhan+dha phaṭa swā hā: bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la rak+ṣa rak+ṣa swā hā: lus ngag yid gsum bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: na mash+tsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra kro dhā ya: hu lu hu lu: tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha: bhan+dha bhan+dha: ha na ha na: a mṛte hūm̐ phaṭa: bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum byad du bcug pa phye phye khrol khrol: oṃ hrīḥbadz+ra bud+dhā dharmā saṅghākīrti sarba karma: lus ngag yid gsum bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: zhi ba shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: ༈ na mo rat+na tra yā ya: shes pa rin ta ho he si dhi sa ma ya: du she pra ti bya ba lo ki te swā hā: oṃ badz+ra bhin+dha hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā: lus ngag yid gsum bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: oṃ hrīḥbadz+ra dz+wa la sarba karma bhin+dha ya: ha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ mā ma sarba bhin+dha bhin+dha dza ye bi dza ye:

ma ma badz+ra sarba u tsit+ta: a pa ra tsit+ta: ma ra byer byer: pra mar+dha ye: ma ma hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā: lus ngag yid gsum bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: oṃ shān+tiṃ ka ri ṇi ye ma ma badz+ra dz+nyā na pra yats+tsha: ma ma bhi dha ra ya ha ha hi hi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa: pra ka ra na pañca la swā hā: karma badz+ra rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā: lus ngag yid gsum bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: ā+om̐ ā+om̐ ā+om̐ bud+dhā kīrti dhu ru dhu ru: lus kyi dbang po phye phye khrol khrol: sa ma yā: sa ma yā: sa ma yā: ā+om̐ ā+om̐ ā+om̐ phaṭa: āḥ.āḥ.āḥdharmā kīrti dhu ru dhu ru: ngag gi dbang po phye phye khrol khrol: sa ma yā: sa ma yā: sa ma yā: āḥ.āḥ.āḥphaṭa: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ saṅghā kīrti dhu ru dhu ru: yid kyi dbang po phye phye khrol khrol: sa ma yā: sa ma yā: sa ma yā: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ āḥhūm̐: e ho shud+dhe shud+dhe: yaṃ ho shud+dhe shud+dhe: baṃ ho shud+dhe shud+dhe: raṃ ho shud+dhe shud+dhe: laṃ ho shud+dhe shud+dhe: e yaṃ baṃ raṃ laṃ shud+dhe shud+dhe: a a a swā hā: lus ngag yid gsum bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: ā+om̐ shang shang hūm̐: tri hrīḥmā sa ma ya phaṭa: thums khrol shang shang swā hā: lus ngag yid gsum bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: ā+om̐ dhe ba nag po bdag la rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa: lus ngag yid gsum bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: ā+om̐ nag po ti pa tsa bag tu phye phye khrol khrol: oṃ dhe ba tsan+d+ra ghan+ti ghan+ti: kha shi na kha shi na: badz+ra badz+ra: so ri so ri: tsu ru tsu ru: u li u li: mu tra mu tra: mu dra yaḥm hā bhai ra bha: man+t+ra sarba lo ke swā hā: ban dgra a mu ka tsa sbur srog nan: snying la gzir breng shag yaṃ rbad: e hur thums dza: khaṃ shag ro myags mug ti rbad ya: bdag la ngan sngags kyi gnod pa byas pa thams cad shig shig phye phye khrol khrol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra tri ga dza phaṭa:

shig phyungs sarba sha trūṃ a ta ha ra swā hā: lus ngag yid gsum bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: zhi ba shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: bcings pa'i rigs thams cad sarba a pa na ye swā hā: ༈ sku gsung thugs kyi byad 'grol/ oṃ badz+ra kā ya gling zlog: lus bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: oṃ badz+ra hi baṃ gar+bha ya zlog: ngag bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: oṃ badz+ra hi ka nan zlog: yid bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: lus ngag yid gsum bcings pa thams cad sarba a pa na ye swā hā: oṃ phra men ma mu ru su phye phye khrol khrol: pa ta s+t+wam+bha ya phye phye khrol khrol: pra ti s+t+wam+bha ya phye phye khrol khrol: mu kha s+t+wam+bha ya phye phye khrol khrol: ku ru s+t+wam+bha ya phye phye khrol khrol: mo ha s+t+wam+bha ya phye phye khrol khrol: bud+dha ni s+t+wam+bha ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa: lus ngag yid gsum bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol sarba a pa na ye swā hā: oṃ ta ku shaṃ shaṃ phye phye khrol khrol: bha ta li phye phye khrol khrol: bha ra li phye phye khrol khrol: bha kha mu khi phye phye khrol khrol: sarba duṣ+ṭān phye phye khrol khrol: oṃ e ka pa ta s+t+waṃ nan: mu stegs kyi sbyor ba ngan pa thams cad phye phye khrol khrol zlog bh+yo: te tsu ha te: ma tsu te: tsu ta ka: bhi ta ma te: te kha bhe: de ba bha mo: na li tsi ti: bha ke li ta ka hūm̐: mu stegs sprel slag can gyi sbyor ba ngan pa thams cad phye phye khrol khrol: bdag gi mi nor zhing khang la gnod pa'i rigs thams cad phye phye khrol khrol: lus ngag yid gsum la phra men gyi rigs thams cad kyis bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: ban dgra a mu ka du raṃ tri yaṃ tri: hrīd ḍh+rid phyungs srog gzir nan phyungs: e hur thums dza: khaṃ shag ro myags mug ti rbad yā: ngan sngags kyi dbal so zug pa thon thon phyungs phyungs phye phye khrol khrol: oṃ bud+dha ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa:

lus ngag yid gsum bcings pa thams cad phye phye khrol khrol: oṃ badz+ra dhu ma gha ye na maḥswā hā: badz+ra bha ra he: kro tī kā li: ha ri ni sa: ā we sha ya: ha badz+ra ḍā ki nī: rdo rje mkha' 'gros bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: ri rat+na ḍā ki nī: rin chen mkha' 'gros bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: ni pad+ma ḍā ki nī: pad+ma mkha' 'gros bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: sa karma ḍā ki nī: las kyi mkha' 'gros bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis ngag mnan gyi sbyor ba ngan pa thams cad phye phye khrol khrol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ya ma tha: ya ra k+sha: tsa pa tri: phu ni na nri: a phye phye a shig shig a khrol khrolaḥ dza ni si ni: 'bri yal yal byer: ha ri dha pa tra phye phye: traṃ pa ta hri ṭha: byi na yal yal: 'bri ni bh+yo: si ni dza: lus ngag yid gsum bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: kī la ya bdag la srungs shig rak+ṣa: rā tsa bdag la srungs shig rak+ṣa: ma hā bdag la srungs shig rak+ṣa: nā ga srungs shig rak+ṣa: ya ma srungs shig rak+ṣa: badz+ra srungs shig rak+ṣa: du traṃ srungs shig rak+ṣa: ga du srungs shig rak+ṣa: phu tri srungs shig rak+ṣa: su tri srungs shig rak+ṣa: du yag srungs shig rak+ṣa: de ba srungs shig rak+ṣa: dz+wa la dhe ba srungs shig rak+ṣa: ka pa bha gha du sha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa: lus ngag yid gsum bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: ā+om̐ a ya ma du nā ga tsa tri she: oṃ nag po ti pa tsa ya nā ga rak+ṣa: raṃ raṃ raṃ raṃ tsa ma ri phyungs: nā ga phu mā ra ya: khaṃ khaṃ khaṃ khaṃ tsa ma ri phyungs: nā ga phu mā ra ya: yaṃ yaṃ yaṃ yaṃ tsa ma ri phyungs: nā ga phu mā ra ya: laṃ laṃ laṃ laṃ tsa ma ri phyungs: nā ga phu mā ra ya: oṃ phe laṃ hūm̐ phaṭa: gtad khrom zhi bar gyur cig shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: oṃ ma hā de ba shrī ral pa can: khaṃ khaṃ: tshig tshig: e e: laṃ laṃ: yaṃ yaṃ: baṃ baṃ: raṃ raṃ: saṃ saṃ: rbad bh+yo: man+t+ra gu h+ya rbad bh+yo thing thing khrol:

lus ngag yid gsum bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: oṃ badz+ra sarba duṣ+ṭān ma hā de ba u ma de bī: dbang phyug yab yum gyis bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: ya ma rā tsa ma ma ru lu gshin rje dang ma mos bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: e ka dzā ṭi ma mo e ka dzā ṭis bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: ru tra dun ting bdud pho mos bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: shu la rā dza btsan dang rgyal pos bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: sa nā ga phu nā ga kro tī shwa rī klu pho mos bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: yak+sha yak+mo gnod sbyin pho mos bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: pa sha mi ki dhe ba a gza' dang yul lhas bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: tīr+thi ka mu stegs pho mos bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: yak+sha yak+mo srin po pho mos bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: mun mun pa dmu yis bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: badz+ra sā dhu triḥhaṃ shaṃ triḥru tri tri rdo rje legs pa dang 'gong po the'u rang gis bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: dza du tri raṃḥm baṃ ril brag srin dang bsen mos bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: giṅka ra yaṃ tri ging dang ru tras bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: ma hā kā la a se la mgon po dang a phyis bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: tog na 'dre ruṃ yul 'dre pho mos bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: tri pa shang ling byi nā ya ka bgegs pho mos bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: ḍā ki nī mkha' 'gro mas bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: sarba hring hring dzaḥlus ngag yid gsum bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: shi ta ra ra phu phu: ru ru phu phu: de ba ta pa shi: su ga ta pa shi phu: hal khyi nag pos lus ngag yid gsum bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: oṃ bag sha ya: badz+ra dzi ta ha: kha shān+tiṃ shag shag: byer byer: yar yar: lus ngag yid gsum bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol:

oṃ ma la yag pa byer: dzaṃ bha ya byer: ya zlog bh+yo: e ka yak+sha dza ya tsa shān+tiṃ: lus ngag yid gsum bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: s+t+wam+bha ya byer: mo ha ya byer: dzaṃ bha ya byer: ya zlog bh+yo: lus ngag yid gsum bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: oṃ ma hā rid swā hā: ma hā de ba swā hā: ma hā mo pad swā hā: phra men gyi sbyor ba ngan pa thams cad las grol bar gyur cig: ti kra ma tsi ta nan: badz+ra tshin+dha tshin+dha: shān+ti shān+ti: shag byer: de ba byer: phra men gyi sbyor ba ngan pa mo ha ya byer: sbyor ba ngan pa zlog bh+yo: dzi tsi ta shad ril thums rbad thums rbad: lus ngag yid gsum bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: mnan pa las grol bar gyur cig: dha ra bag sha ku ta kha kha: kha pa 'u sha la na ta pa sa: glad pa ta ku ma tsa ma lu ku ya bdag la rak+ṣa rak+ṣa: oṃ ma hā kā la a yur thums rbad: dha hi ta hi ta ra: pa sha ku sha kha khas nga kha 'u sha la na pa sa glad pa la ta ku ma tsa bdag la rak+ṣa: pra ma khrol: ya ma khrol: ya ma du tri khrol: sa ma ya khrol: du ru tri pa la shig khrol: sa ma ya khrol: ni la rat+na khrol: pad+ma rat+na ya ni khrol swā hā: ya ma ni khrol swāhā: lus ngag yid gsum bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: phra men gyi sbyor ba ngan pa thams cad phye phye khrol khrol: oṃ badz+ra kro dha wāk phye phye khrol khrol: ma ti 'ur pa phye phye khrol khrol: lce ti 'ur pa phye phye khrol khrol: tir ti 'ur pa phye phye khrol khrol: 'ur ti 'ur pa phye phye khrol khrol: lus ngag yid gsum bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: phra men gyi sbyor ba ngan pa thams cad phye phye khrol khrol: oṃ hrīḥ.oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa: mnan pa thon thon: oṃ kā ya wāk khrol khrol: sa ma ya tsit+ta khrol khrol: pra be sha ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa: lus ngag yid gsum bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: oṃ badz+ra ma hā tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa s+pho ṭa ya gh+rig khaṃ hūm̐ phaṭa:

ban+dha tra tha hūm̐ phaṭa: bsdams pa khrol khrol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ a bhi ṣiñca kā ya wāk tsit+ta hūm̐ phaṭa: ā+om̐ tig nan a mu ka mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ gu ta na bha sa be ta phu: tsa ta rbad ni phu graṃ sha na sa no swo ni swā hā: oṃ rak+sha nag po ban dgra'i srog la mā ra ya rbad sod: oṃ khrag rtsa rbud: snying khrag rbud: mā ra ya khas khas rbud: oṃ thums thums nri sha thums ni ban dgra mā ra ya rbad sod thums thums: bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: aḥkaḥsaḥmaḥraḥtsaḥshaḥdaḥraḥsaḥmaḥraḥya phaṭa: mkha' 'gros bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: gser gyi rus sbal sngags/ oṃ kā li kā li ma hā kā li ye 'ur 'ur rgya 'ur: phu phu: raṃ raṃ: nyil nyil: srid gsum mgon po khaṃ mi rgyu: si si ling: khro chu phan phen: ga ga go dzi sa le: gho sdam raṃ raṃ: lus ngag yid gsum bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: oṃ ma hā kā li mo ta ye swā hā: oṃ mar mer thab thib naṃ thong byer: gnam sa sdod byer: nyi zla sdod char chags: 'byung ba'i dgra zlog: gshed kyi dug chings: dmigs pa'i rten la bh+yoḥ lus ngag yid gsum bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: oṃ ma hā kā li ye phya brub brub: ma ma sngo ta sngo ta keg ye swāhā: na na dha ra dha ra phya brub brub: ma ma e e ye swā hā: e e ye phya brub brub: ma ma yaṃ yaṃ ye swā hā: yaṃ yaṃ ye phya brub brub: ma ma baṃ baṃ 'u ye swā hā: baṃ baṃ ye phya brub brub: ma ma raṃ raṃ ji ye swā hā: raṃ raṃ ye phya brub brub: ma ma sang sang kung ye swā hā: saṃ saṃ ye phya brub brub: ma ma su su ting ting kung ye swā hā: ma ma ka ra ka ra shang ye swā hā: ma ma char chu 'u ye swā hā: ma ma sngo ta sngo ta keg ye swā hā: 'byung ba lnga yis bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol:

spar kha'i sngags/ oṃ khu khu ma shag pa zlog: kha la bha ti zlog: traṃ su she'u zlog: bha ta yan zlog: khaṃ tig nan zlog: phu sha he zlog: ma ra ya zlog: sha tsi yan zlog: lus ngag yid gsum bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum bcings pa thams cad sarba a pa na ye swā hā: byad 'grol gyi sngags bsdus pa/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ kā ya wāk tsit+ta k+ṣaya: badz+ra tshin+dha tsa hā: shān+tiṃ shān+tiṃ: shag byer: yar yar s+t+wam+bha ya byer: dzaṃ bha ya byer: mo ha ya byer: ya zlog bh+yo: ban bon sngags pa'i bsam sbyor ngan pas mnan pa dang bcings pa dang: bsdams pa dang: gzir pa dang: byad du bcug pa thams cad phye phye khrol khrol swā hā: gnod pa'i rigs thams cad zhi ba shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: phye phye khrol khrol: a ā: i ī: u ū: ṛ ṝ: l̥ l̥̄: e ai: o au: aṃ āḥ ka kha ga gha nga: tsa tsha dza dzha nya: ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa: ta tha da dha na: pa pha ba bha ma: ya ra la wa sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣa: oṃ ye dharmā he tu pra bha bāḥhe tun+te ṣān+ta thā ga to h+ya ba data: te ṣāñca yo ni ro dha e waṃ bā dī ma hā shra ma ṇaḥye swā hā: bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum la pha rol gyi mi dang mi ma yin pas bcings pa dang: mnan pa dang: bsdams pa dang: gzir pa dang: byad du bcug pa thams cad phye phye khrol khrol: sarba a pa na ye swā hā: nad thams cad sarba a pa na ye swā hā: gdon thams cad sarba a pa na ye swā hā: bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu sarba a pa na ye swā hā: ye 'drog sum brgya drug cu sarba a pa na ye swā hā: glo bur bdun brgya nyi shu sarba a pa na ye swā hā: ltas ngan brgyad cu rtsa gcig gi gnod pa thams cad sarba a pa na ye swā hā: gdon bgegs rkyen ngan bar chad thams cad sarba a pa na ye swā hā: mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi ba shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: sngags byang bklag chog ngo mtshar can : rab nyi shu rtsa gcig:

'bring bcu bzhi: tha ma bdun bzla'o: sngags chu bum pa'i nang du blug go: de nas rang gi 'khor rnams 'khru ba dang 'thung bar bya'o: des rang dang mi phyugs 'khor dang bcas pa 'khru ba dang gtor ba sogs byas pa de yi nus pas rang dang mi phyugs bza' bran 'khor dang bcas pa la ban bon dang sngags kyi mthu dang lus ngag yid gsum mnan pa dang: bcings pa dang*/ bsdams pa dang: phra men gyi rigs thams cad kyis gnod mi nus so: sngags kyi nus pa skye ba gsum du med par byas pa yang lan gcig gis grol bar 'gyur ro: rang gi nus pa mchog tu rgyas par 'gyur ro: rang gis sngags bzlas pa rnams: brgya: stong: khri: 'bum: bye ba: sa ya: dung phyur du 'phel lo: rang gi chos skyong gi rten la gtor ro: khyim dang sgrub khang gi byang phyogs su gtor ro: them pa dang srang kha la gtor ro: rang gi mal sa dang sa phyogs 'di ru gnod pa byas sam snyam pa la gtor ro: des rang gi srung ma gshed du babs pa rnams rang grol du 'gro'o: zhing dang khang pa la gtor na sel gyi rigs kyis gnod mi nus so: 'di'i sngags rnams rab gser gyis bri: 'bring dngul: tha ma mtshal gyis bri: ma grub na snag tshas bri: de rdza'i gwa 'u so btang ba'i nang du bcug la: khang pa'i nang byang phyogs su sbas na khang sel gyi rigs thams cad kyis gnod par mi nus so: zhing gi dkyil du sbas na gong bzhin gnod mi nus so: rtag tu lo legs par 'gyur ro: rang gi lus la bcangs na: gzhan dag gi mthu dang: nus pa dang: sbyor ba ngan pa 'gong chog gi rigs dang: sel dang mnan pa'i rigs ci byas pas kyang gnod mi nus so: gong bzhin du 'thung ba dang: 'khru ba dang: sngags lus la bcangs na: phra men dang gnod pa'i rigs thams cad gdan du bting yang gnod mi nus so: gnod pa'i rigs thams cad rang grol du 'gro'o: 'di'i bum chu nyi ma rtse shar la nangs ma gtan du 'thung na: sgrub pa'i rigs ci byas pa yang chud mi zos te myur du 'grub bo:

sngags kyi nus pa gzhan las che: ma grub pa rnams myur du 'grub: grub pa rnams nus pa gzhan las che'o: rang la ye shes pa dang dmod pa drag sngags kyi lha tshogs rnams rang bzhin gyis 'du'o: ci bcol ba'i las rnams byed do: bsnyen sgrub las sbyor gyi rtags rnams myur du thon no: rang gzhan gyis mnan pas mi non: bcings pas mi 'ching: bsdams pas mi sdom: phar la mthu dang gnod pa gang byed nus pa gzhan las che'o: skye ba gsum du lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib thams cad byang zhing dag par 'gyur ro: sngags kyi nus pa thams cad kyang mchog tu bskyed do: ngag 'grol gyi rigs thams cad kyang 'di la tshang: sna re la bstan pa rnams dang mi 'dra'o: 'dzul chog gi rigs thams cad 'di la tshang: 'dzu+ul chog gi 'khor lo la brten pa rnams col chung ngo: 'dzul chog dang ngag 'grol 'di las zab pa yod re kan: ༈ rtags kyi rim pa ni: de yang rang la gzhan gyis ngag mnan pa dang: bcings pa dang: bsdams pa dang: mthu byas pa'i rtags su: lces lab mi shes par skrangs pa dang: lkog ma dang mgul pa 'gags nas na ba dang: sngags bgrang mi shes pa dang: bgrang yang sgra mi dag pa dang: lce yi mdog 'gyur ba dang: rgya gram du gas pa dang*/ kha bcings par rmi ba dang: lce la phur pa btab pa rmi ba dang: chos po ti'i 'og dang mchod rten gyi 'og tu non pa dang: dong gting ring du tshud pa dang: re ba nag pos btums pa rmi ba dang: mun pa nag po'i phugs su tshud pa dang: brag phug stong pa dang: khang stong dang yul stong rmi ba dang: gcig nas gcig tu 'dzul ba rmi ba dang: khang stong rdib la khad pa'i nang du phyin pa rmi ba dang: zam pa dang lam rgya gram gyi dkyil du nyal ba rmi ba dang: ri rong dog po'i rtse nas rbab tu lhung la khad pa dang: lhung ba rmi ba dang: lha khang dang lder bzo rmi ba dang: dngos su'ang rang nyams shed chung ba dang: sngags bzla snying mi 'dod pa dang:

bzlas kyang ldab ldib tu song ba dang: sgrub pa byas kyang nus pa chung la bar chad mang ba dang: rang khro zhing 'tshig pa za ba dang: snying mi dga' ba dang: bskyed rim mi gsal ba dang: lus lci zhing 'thibs pa dang: gos mi gtsang ba gyon pa dang: mi gtsang ba'i 'dam rdzab tu phyin pa rmi ba dang: ro khur gyi gling du phyin pa dang: nad pa skyug log rmi ba dang: mtsho dang chu mig rlan rlon gyi 'dam du bying ba dang phyin pa rmi ba dang: grog po chen po'i 'og tu tshud pa dang: khyer la khad pa dang: ri nyil ba dang: brag phug gting ring du 'dzul ba rmi ba dang: dngos su'ang shes pa gnad du mi phebs par yed yed pa dang: de ltar byung na lus ngag yid gsum mnan pa dang bcings pa dang bsdams pa'i rtags so: rang la gzhan gyis mthu byas pa'i rtags su: don med par snying mi dga' ba dang: mi la 'thab 'dod pa dang: ca co 'bog snying 'dod pa dang: nang du 'thab mo mang ba dang: rmi lam du mi ngo mi shes pa dang: mon pa dang: a tsa ras rang la brgyab pa dang: 'thab pa dang: rdo'i char 'bab pa dang thog 'bab pa dang: mda' dang mdung dang gri brgyab pa rmi ba dang: rlung nag 'tshubs pa dang: ri gzar nas rdo rbab byung ba dang: dmag gis bskor ba rmis na mthu byas pa'i rtags so: dmag mang po dang ban de dang sngags bon gyi dmag gis bskor ba rmi ba dang: gcan zan dang bya nag gis ded pa rmi ba dang: dngos su rang gi gos la gris rma byung ba dang: ltas ngan gyi sems can byung ba dang: bud med dang mi mang pos mdzo dang rta dang bong drel la sga stong gtad nas rang la sgo nyal byed pa rmi ba dang: rtags de rnams tshur rang la byung na mis rang la byas pa'i rtags te: de rnams ni mthu byad yod pa'i rtags so: ༈ gdams pa 'di'i lo rgyus ni: sngon rgya gar gyi yul du las kyi mkha' 'gros mdzad de: rgya gar rdo rje gdan gyi byang phyogs su mchod rten sngon po'i khri 'phang la sbas so:

rdo rje gdan gyi dus mchod la slob dpon khrag 'thung nag po byon nas tshogs kyi dgongs pa mdzad cing yod tsa na: mkha' 'gros lung bstan byung nas rdo rje gdan gyi byang phyogs kyi mchod rten sngon po'i khri 'phang la gsang sngags thams cad kyi nus pa nyams pa gso ba dang: man ngag mkhan rnams kyi nus pa med par bya ba dang: rang gi nus pa thams cad mchog tu skyed pa'i gdams pa yod do: zhes lung bstan byung nas: der slob dpon gyis gzigs pas: byang phyogs kyi mchod rten de'i khri 'phang la me stag dmar phrom phrom 'dug pa gzigs nas: der mkha' 'gro la gtor ma phul nas: de nas gzong gis g.yeng bas gser gyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa gcig byung ngo: de bshigs pa'i nang nas gsang ba'i man ngag gsang sngags thams cad kyi nus pa nyams pa gso ba'i man ngag: nus pa thams cad mchog tu skyed pa'i man ngag 'di byung ngo: der slob dpon thugs dgyes nas mkha' 'gro rnams la gtor tshogs rgya chen po phul lo: khrag 'thung nag pos gnubs ban sangs rgyas ye shes la gnang ngo: des rim par brgyud nas: kong po lta bar gnas pa'i bla ma khro tshang 'brug lha la: dge bshes g.yung drung rgyal mtshan gyis zhus so: khong la sngags dbon bsod nams rdo rjes zhus: de nas sangs rgyas blo bde'o: 'dzul chog ngag 'grol mi khur gcig las 'di zab bo: bu slob snying dang 'dra ba ma gtogs pa: gzhan la ma spel cig: thams cad tshang ba 'di min pa su la'ang med do: 'di yod ces kha ru ma 'don cig: 'di ni rang gi srog skyob yin: 'di dang ldan na gzhan gyis rang la mthu dang gnod pa'i rigs ci byas kyang mi tshugs so: 'di yi bum chus lkug pa dang: bu chung kha lji ba lan bdun du 'khru ba dang: 'thung du bcug na kha smra'o: sku'i rgya rgya rgya: gsung gi rgya rgya rgya: thugs kyi rgya rgya rgya: gdams pa 'di la sngags bzla ba'i dus su dmigs pa 'di bzhin bsgom mo:

rang nyid rdo rje gtsug tor phyag stong du yod pa: phyag thams cad gcod byed kyi ral gri bsnams pa: dbu stong du yod pa: spyan bye ba brgya phrag 'bum du yod pa: me dpung 'bar ba'i dkyil na bzhugs pa srid gsum zil gyis gnon pa gcig tu bsgom: spyi bor oṃ dkar po: mgrin par āḥdamar po: thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po bsgom: de yang spyi bor rnam par snang mdzad: mgrin par snang ba mtha' yas: snying khar rdo rje sems dpa' bsgom mo: dmigs pa 'di bsgom pa tsam gyis ngag mnan pa dang: bcings pa thams cad rang grol la 'gro'o: rang gi ya so bcu la hūm̐ las khro bo bcu bsgom: ma so hrīḥlas khro mo bcu bsgom: lce ral gri ngar mar bsgom: sma ra me dpung 'bar bar bsgom: mgrin par nyi ma dang zla ba bsgom: rang lus me dpung chen por bsgom: lus ngag yid gsum la gnod pa'i rigs thams cad bya sgro me la bsregs pa bzhin du rdul bun gyis tshig par bsgom: de nas sngags bzla'o: rjes la ma hā mu dra sgoms: bzlas pa'i dus su smra bcad bya'o: shin tu zab pa'i gdams pa 'di: slob dpon khrag 'thung nag pos rdo rje gdan gyi byang phyogs nas: mchod rten khri 'phang nas bton pa'o: 'di'i brgyud pa ni: slob dpon khrag 'thung nag po: sangs rgyas ye shes: khro tshang 'brug lha: g.yung drung rgyal mtshan: bsod nams rdo rje: sangs rgyas blo bde: sras rgyal mtshan: bla ma chos skyong: bla ma shākya seṅge la'o: 'di'i lag len la: de nas bla ma yi dam gyi phrin las gzhung bsrang: bum pa bskyed chog bdag bskyed dang mdun bskyed gsal ba'i ngang nas: byad 'grol gser gyi lde'u mig ngag bcad pas tshar bdun bzla: de nas byad du bcug pa de re ba gru gsum pa'i steng du bzhag: spyi bor sāts+tsha: yan lag tshon skud kyis bcing: gos nag gcig mgo zhabs bsgyur la gon te: bskyed rim phog: rang nyid bdag bskyed gsal bas byad 'grol bar bya'o:

lo rgyus rgyas pa sogs gzhung logs su gsal lo: dum pa rgyas g.yung gi rdza lhud mo nas bton pa'i gter gzhung nas gsal bar logs su 'grol ba'o: 1$0000250༄༅: byad 'grol gser gyi lde'u mig gi ngag 'don bzhugs so: 1$0000300rang nyid rdo rje gtsug tor phyag stong du yod pa: phyag thams cad la gcod byed kyi ral gri bsnams pa: dbu yang stong du yod pa: spyan bye ba brgya phrag 'bum du yod pa: me dpung 'bar ba'i dkyil na bzhugs pa: srid gsum zil gyis non pa zhig tu bsgom: spyi bor oṃ dkar po: mgrin par āḥdamar po: thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po bsgom: de yang spyi bor rnam par snang mdzad: mgrin par snang ba mtha' yas: snying khar rdo rje sems dpa' bsgom: dmigs pa 'di bsgom pa tsam gyis ngag mnan pa dang: bcings pa thams cad 'grol lo: rang gi ya so bcu la hūm̐ bcu las khro bo bcu: ma so hrīḥbacu las khro mo bcu: lce ral gri ngar ma: sma ra me dpung 'bar ba: mgrin pa nyi ma dang zla bar gyur: rang lus me dpung 'bar bas dgra bgegs byad ma gnod byed thams cad gzhob thul gyis bsregs par gyur: hūm̐: khro bo'i rgyal po byad dang ngag 'grol ba rnam par rgyal ba la phyag 'tshal lo: bdag cag gi lus ngag yid gsum la pha rol gyi mi dang mi ma yin pas bsam sbyor ngan pa dang rnam par sdang ba dang gnod par bsam pa dang: ngan sngags byed pa dang: byad du bcug pa dang: gtad khram byed pa dang: khram la 'debs pa dang: rbod gtong byed pa dang: sbyin sreg byed pa dang: ngag mnan pa dang: bcings pa dang: dmod mo byed pa dang: hom dang par bu bskor ba dang: rlung gi 'khor lo bskor ba dang: steng lha yis bcings pa dang: 'og klu yis bcings pa: bar lha srin sde brgyad kyis bcings pa: phra men gyis byad du bcug nas lus ngag yid gsum bcings pa dang: mnan pa thams cad rnam par gzhig tu gsol: rnam par gzhom du gsol:

lus ngag yid gsum bcings pa thams cad khrol tu gsol: nges par khrol tu gsol: mthu byad kyis bcings pa thams cad sarba a pa na ye swā hā: lus bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: ngag bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: yid bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: lus ngag yid gsum bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i bden pa dang: bar pa drang srong gi dmod pa dang: phyi pa mu stegs pa'i sbyor ba ngan pa thams cad phye phye khrol khrol: mi nor zhing khang la gnod pa thams cad phye phye khrol khrol: dbang phyug chen po yab yum gyis bcings pa thams cad phye phye khrol khrol: gshin rje pho mos bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: e ka dzā ṭi dang ma mos bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: bdud pho dang bdud mos bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: btsan dang rgyal pos bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: klu dang klu mos bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: gnod sbyin dang gnod sbyin mos bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: gza' dang gdong mos bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: yul lha dang yul 'dres bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: mu stegs pho mos bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: srin po dang dmu yis bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: rdo rje legs pa dang thel 'gong gis bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: mgon po dang a phyis bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: yul 'dre pho mos bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: bgegs dang 'byung pos bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: mkha' 'gro dang shugs 'gros bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: hal khyi nag po 'khor dang bcas pas lus ngag yid gsum bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: 'byung ba lngas bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: phra men gyi sbyor ba ngan pa thams cad phye phye khrol khrol: ngag mnan gyi sbyor ba ngan pa thams cad phye phye khrol khrol: gtad khram gyi sbyor ba ngan pa thams cad phye phye khrol khrol:

gza' dang sde brgyad ming sring gi byad dang gtad khrol khrol: klu brgyad kyi byad dang gtad khrol khrol: sde brgyad kyi byad dang gtad khrol khrol: lus ngag yid gsum gyi byad dang gtad khrol khrol: shar nas klu sbrul mgo gsum pa'i byad dang gtad khrol khrol: lho nas klu sbrul mgo lnga pa'i byad dang gtad khrol khrol: nub nas klu sbrul mgo bdun pa'i byad dang gtad khrol khrol: byang nas klu sbrul mgo dgu pa'i byad dang gtad khrol khrol: klu rgyal rigs kyi byad dang gtad khrol khrol: klu rje rigs kyi byad dang gtad khrol khrol: klu dmangs rigs kyi byad dang gtad khrol khrol: klu gdol pa'i rigs kyi byad dang gtad khrol khrol: klu bram ze'i rigs kyi byad dang gtad khrol khrol: klu btsan rigs kyi byad dang gtad khrol khrol: klu gnyan rigs kyi byad dang gtad khrol khrol: klu srin rigs kyi byad dang gtad khrol khrol: sa bdag 'dzin pos bcings pa khrol khrol: sdom po khra bos bcings pa khrol khrol: gyong po zha bos bcings pa khrol khrol: gza' klu sa bdag rje blon gyis bcings pa khrol khrol: gshin rje dang las gshin gyis bcings pa khrol khrol: rgyal po dang rgyal 'gong gis bcings pa khrol khrol: btsan dang ma mos bcings pa khrol khrol: bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa'i lus ngag yid gsum bcings pa khrol: bsdams pa lhod: mnan pa thegs: zos pa skyugs: shi ba gsos: bsam sbyor ngan pa lhod: lus kyi dbang po phye phye khrol khrol: ngag gi dbang po phye phye khrol khrol: yid kyi dbang po phye phye khrol khrol: bla bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: rus bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: ming bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: gzugs bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: kha rje dbang thang bcings pa phye phye khrol khrol: bsdams pa dang bcings pa dang mnan pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: bsdams pa bcings pa mnan pa byad mthur bcug pa thams cad dz+wa la raṃ raṃ mā ra ya phaṭa:

ces mnan pa theg: bcings pa rnams chad par bsam: me hom la lan bdun 'gong: gos bsgyur: bum pas khrus bya khar 'thung: phyogs gtsang sar sdod: de ltar lan gsum gyis gtad khram thams cad dang mthu byad ngan sbyor thams cad grol bar the tshom med do: zhag gsum gyi bar mi dang gnas gdon chen grib can spang: ྈ ra mā sngas su mi 'jug: shes rab rigs ngan dang mi 'grogs: slob ma snying lta bu ma gtogs: gang byung byung gar thod du mi bya: rang la zlog nyen yod do: shu bhaṃ: :
